title: Detroit Guided Pedicab Tour Explore the City in Comfort
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Detroit's vibrant neighborhoods and rich history on a guided pedicab tour. With skilled drivers leading the way, you'll encounter hidden murals and architectural gems that tell the story of the Motor City. Relax in eco-friendly pedicabs as you take in the sights and sounds, making this an ideal experience for both tourists and locals alike. Enjoy a personalized journey that highlights the unique culture of Detroit, ensuring a memorable exploration of the city.

- 1-hour guided pedicab tour through the heart of Detroit
- Visit hidden murals and architectural highlights
- Eco-friendly pedicabs for a comfortable ride
- Perfect for tourists and locals looking to learn about Detroit's culture
